patterns.what_worked: Verifying every client claim directly against the local wow-ui-source checkout (all five origin/ branches) instead of trusting the review text; reusing ONE function object for both the global and the SlashCmdList registration so identity is a testable pin; proving every pin by reverting on COPIES in /tmp/opencode so the working tree was never disturbed
patterns.what_was_hard: The harness's 'no locale defines a key enUS does not' invariant meant enUS had to gain the new keys too, or ten locales would have gone red; and the changelog's gear-panel claim was wrong in a way that needed the client XML checked on five branches rather than reasoned about
patterns.skill_gap: The Extras harness lives in the repo but references the MAIN repo's Tests/harness/mock_contract.lua, so a copy-based revert proof needs the parent directory scaffolded too

escalation.recommendation: Main-add-on lane: call _G.TacoTipExtrasToggleLeaderboard (the function published at TacoTip_Extras/RankBrowser.lua:2852-2860) instead of rawget(SlashCmdList, 'TACOTIPRANKS'), which is nil at dispatch time on every client
